title: KAD-PI Deterministic Shadow Economic Evaluator
non_scope: changing production economic router execution authority (routeEconomically)
altering production route selection or executing paid spend
background network polling loops or credential scraping
acceptance_criteria: Wayfinder architectural decision establishes side-effect-free shadow evaluator wrapping existing router inputs/results.
Explicit quota semantics contract distinguishes remaining_fraction, used_fraction, reset_at, window_duration, scope, allowed, limit_reached, freshness, epistemic_class.
Deterministic scope matching isolates model-specific from provider/account-wide quota windows without collapsing.
Reset-aware economic scoring optimizes for useful utilization subject to accepted policy without ML or hidden weights.
Invariants strictly enforced: paid_authorized=false never recommends paid; UNKNOWN never treated as 100%; STALE cannot outrank fresh.
Shadow evaluation has zero authority to mutate actual production routing or trigger network calls.
All 18 required TDD test cases (T1-T18) pass, and previous usage-bridge behaviors are verified traceable.
Shadow evaluation is surfaced through bin/kad budget and control plane view-model with distinct [SHADOW]/[ADVISORY] labeling.
All 446+ regression tests and full test suite remain green with zero regressions.
description: Deterministic shadow economic evaluator evaluating quota-aware economic preference without granting telemetry mutation authority over routing.
